capabilities: Render .ipynb notebook files when opened from the file explorer
Display markdown cells using Obsidian's own renderer
Show code cells with Python syntax highlighting and execution-count badges
Render outputs as monospace text, scrollable DataFrame tables, inline images, or cleaned error tracebacks
Switch back to the raw JSON editor via right-click Open with
disambiguation: Not a Jupyter runner or editor; it only displays existing .ipynb files and cannot execute code.
extras: Desktop only (uses Obsidian's desktop file APIs); supports notebook format v4 (nbformat 4); the directory listing notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian shows .ipynb files as raw JSON, so notebooks stored in a vault cannot be read as notebooks.
summary: Notebook viewer that renders .ipynb Jupyter files inside Obsidian with formatted markdown cells, syntax-highlighted code, and inline outputs.
